title: 'Taiwan Travelogue' wins the 2026 International Booker Prize
summary: The novel is the first work translated from Mandarin Chinese to win the award, which celebrates its 10th anniversary this year.
contentText:
Taiwan Travelogue author Yáng Shuāng-zǐ, left, and translator Lin King are the first Taiwanese and Taiwanese-American winners of the International Booker Prize. They are pictured above in London on Monday.'/> The novel is the first work translated from Mandarin Chinese to win the award, which celebrates its 10th anniversary this year.

(Image credit: Adrian Dennis)
